title: Per-worktree ImageMap identity|ImageMap identity is ref-derived (ImageTarget.ImageMapName pkg/model/image_target.go:60). Register retagged refs under worktree-scoped ImageMaps so two worktrees building the same Dockerfile never share an ImageMap. Cache: same branch warm, different branches diverge after first changed layer. Integration test: two worktrees build same Dockerfile -> distinct tags, distinct ImageMaps, stable pods keep main image.
notes: merged to master (round 2 rework; validator approved)

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
DONE: Per-worktree ImageMap identity (plan §4.4) — committed 7b592cb30 in .worktrees/tk-1zq (branch tk-1zq, based on current master 2f1ab7aa3 which carries tk-7gg tag rewrite + tk-ntx boundary pass).

WHAT LANDED:
- internal/tiltfile/worktree/boundary.go: renameDerived now scopes each clone's ref-derived ImageMap identity to its worktree — ImageMapSpec.Selector becomes <ref>-wt-<worktree> via new WorktreeImageMapSelector (escaped through container.WorktreeTagSuffix, the same token as tk-7gg's tag surface; result stays a parseable image ref). Clone base-image ImageMapDeps are scoped identically so multi-stage build graphs stay inside the worktree. Shared (main-defined) manifests keep the bare selector (one shared ImageMap, plan §3); scoping is gated on IsCloneName. renameDerivedAll/ApplyBoundary now propagate errors (invalid selectors surface as the run's load error).
- internal/tiltfile/worktree/imagemap_test.go: 10 new acceptance tests — selector scoping/escaping, distinct-per-worktree identity, name-match against own build refs (and no match vs main/other worktrees), full RefSet→AddTagSuffix chain producing distinct refs per worktree, boundary-pass end-to-end (clone scoped / shared bare / two worktrees same Dockerfile distinct ImageMaps / deps rewritten / no input mutation).
- internal/tiltfile/worktree/boundary_test.go: TestApplyBoundary_DerivedNamesRestamped updated to the new contract (it explicitly deferred ImageMap identity to tk-1zq; now asserts scoped selector + ImageMapName).

WHY THIS SHAPE: identity flows everywhere by construction from the scoped selector — toImageMapObjects registers the worktree-scoped ImageMap CR (GC via owner refs on the clone's Tiltfile CR); ImageTarget.Refs derives the build RefSet from the scoped selector so build tags land in the scoped repo (distinct cache lineage; CanReuseRef keys on the ref → no cross-worktree reuse); the default name-match selector matches only the worktree's own build refs; KubernetesApplySpec.ImageMaps / LiveUpdate ImageMapName / engine state.ImageMaps all key on the scoped names with zero additional plumbing.

NOTE (no blocker): tk-7gg's RefSet.WithWorktree tag-suffix path is test-only in production right now (nothing sets it in the build pipeline). With tk-1zq's repo-scoped selectors the tags are already distinct per worktree, so the tag token remains a compatible second isolation layer — not a dependency of this change.

VERIFIED: go test ./internal/tiltfile/worktree/ ./pkg/model/ ./internal/controllers/core/tiltfile/ ./internal/controllers/core/kubernetesapply/ ./internal/engine/... -count=1 — all ok. ./internal/tiltfile has only the 2 known baseline env failures (TestKustomizeFlags/TestKustomizeBin, missing kustomize binary; fail identical on untouched master). go build ./... clean. Private GOCACHE, worktree clean.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text: REJECTED: Two reproduced breaks, both confirmed by executed repro tests (evidence: .agents/match/validations/tk-1zq-evidence.txt @ 9a7410cad in worktree). (1) DEPLOY WIRING: the pass rewrites only m.ImageTargets, but clone deploy targets keep the BARE ImageMaps list stamped at load (K8sTarget.ImageMaps via tiltfile_state.go:1250 WithImageDependencies; DockerComposeTarget.Spec.ImageMaps via svc.ImageMapDeps), while ImageMap CRs are registered under SCOPED names. Production sequence ApplyBoundary (handleLoaded) then InferLiveUpdateSelectors (updateOwnedObjects) hard-fails: model.NewTargetGraph/TopologicalSort errors 'Internal error: Missing target dependency: registry.example.com_api' because K8sTarget.DependencyIDs() yields the bare name — every worktree clone with k8s_yaml/DC deploy of its own build fails to load. If that gate were bypassed, NamesToObjects(spec.ImageMaps) would miss the scoped CRs and ComputeInputHash errors 'missing image map' — deploys never happen. Repro: TestReproCloneK8sImageMapsStale, exact production sequence, FAILS. (2) UN-GATED DEPS REWRITE: the ImageMapDeps scoping block lacks the IsCloneName gate the selector block has, so a shared (bare-named, wtOwned) redefinition carrying multi-stage deps errors 'internal error: \postgres\ is not a worktree clone name' from renameDerived. Repro: TestReproSharedRedefinitionDepsError, FAILS. Also: the task's integration criterion (two worktrees, same Dockerfile, distinct tags/ImageMaps, stable pods keep main image) has no integration test; worker's green suites run the pass in isolation, never the pass→updateOwnedObjects sequence where break (1) lives. Fix: (a) rewrite clone deploy-target image-map lists (K8sTarget.ImageMaps / DC Spec.ImageMaps) to the scoped names in renameDerived — same IsCloneName-gated scoping, e.g. rewrite each entry via WorktreeImageMapSelector or map bare->scoped against the target's own identity; keep shared manifests bare; (b) gate the ImageMapDeps block on IsCloneName(m.Name); (c) add a regression test running ApplyBoundary followed by m.InferLiveUpdateSelectors() for a clone with a k8s deploy target, plus a two-worktrees-same-Dockerfile fixture. New 10 tests themselves pass and are kept — the gap is integration, not the selector math.
